decisions.rightsDescription: Commons states unrestricted redistribution, commercial use and modification; not a Creative Commons license. Do not automatically convert this to CC BY/CC0.
decisions.reason: Original image viewed. Main subject is front-facing and unobstructed but face occupies a relatively small area and 2010 iPhone 3GS pixels look soft; background includes smaller bystanders. Verify face crop sharpness at 600x720, five-stage eye clarity, and the custom free-use grant/attribution independently. Do not treat the image as accepted.
